checkpoint_loading.file: torch.save({'model', 'optimizer', 'lr_scheduler'}) by mace-torch 0.3.16 CheckpointBuilder; read with torch.load(weights_only=True)
checkpoint_loading.ema: mace tools/train.py saves each checkpoint inside ema.average_parameters(), so 'model' holds the EMA weights (decay 0.99) that its per-epoch eval used; no separate EMA state is stored
checkpoint_loading.into: a deep copy of the wp3.model module (ScaleShiftMACE, float64) whose floating state_dict tensors are first set to NaN, load_state_dict(strict=True) after asserting equal key sets, shapes and dtypes; MACECalculator(models=[...], float64, cpu, head Default), whose module is then asserted to hold every checkpoint tensor bitwise (a tensor the load missed would be NaN, not wp3.model's value)
checkpoint_loading.identity: lr_scheduler.last_epoch equals the epoch of the file name (asserted)
checkpoint_loading.wp3_model: run_train loads the epoch-82 checkpoint into the model and saves the module as wp3.model; the epoch-82 state_dict is bitwise equal to wp3.model's: True

Q1.question: a kept checkpoint whose 5 m21 |far-ref E_b error| (raw F) are all < 25 meV, with the Sr hinge and flank signs right
Q1.reading: the collapse of the first-shell Sr E_b is a property of the training, not of the selection
Q1.caveat: the plan rule cannot discriminate here: Sr0 (Sr_mid), not a first-shell Sr site, has |error| >= 25 meV at every kept checkpoint (-65.7 to -38.1 meV; Initial -43.0), so no checkpoint could meet the rule whatever happened at the first-shell Sr sites; the reading about the first-shell Sr collapse rests on the first-shell-only check beside it, which is met by no checkpoint

beside_first_shell_Sr_only.note: reported beside, not the Q1 rule: the same condition on the two first-shell Sr sites alone (|error| < 25 meV and the sign right at both), to show whether the answer rests on them

Q2.definition: per host and first-shell Sr site, over the models in training order (Initial, then the 20 kept epochs): the first model with |far-ref E_b error| > 25 meV (literal; 'Initial' = already above before any training); the first with error < -25 meV (collapse direction); the first from which every later model has |error| > 25 meV. Each onset is located only to its bracket (previous model, onset]: the epochs between kept checkpoints are not evaluated; the logged m21 RMSE_F and the fraction of its Initial -> epoch-82 fall are given at the onset and as a range over the logged epochs of the bracket
